summary: Single-player 24-seat no-build battle royale on an original island: staging pier, skiff drop and wing-sail glide, nine data-driven weapons in five rarities, eight items, full traversal, ten-phase Riftstorm, server-style bots, spectating and results, all driven by a deterministic in-browser 30Hz authoritative simulation.
notes: No backend: the authoritative match runs in-process behind a LocalTransport, so there is no real networking, prediction or lag compensation. The screenshot is a real production-build frame captured with ?autoplay (the bot AI drives the player's seat, because headless browsers cannot use pointer lock). Not hand-tested with a mouse; real-GPU performance not measured.
